description: Free, read-only: the account's state and limits, or the zones, hostnames or invoices it owns. With api_key, only the objects the key's scope covers and only their invoices (the account view of limits and counts is the same for every key). Called without nip98 it returns signature_required: the exact URL, method and body to sign, the body's sha256 and an unsigned kind 27235 event template (with proof of work for accounts without a paid order). Sign that, then call again with the same arguments plus nip98. Each signed event works once, within 60 s. Secrets that are ours to receive: object tokens, account API keys (jdk_), signed NIP-98 events; never a private key (nsec or 64 hex characters), wallet connection string or seed words. A raw hex key or seed words inside a sentence cannot be caught here.

api_key.description: A scoped account API key (jdk_...) made in the dashboard. It passes through your model context and transcript: treat it like a password. Key model: a key reads (or, with write access, changes) only the objects in its scope, and sees only their invoices; every key reads the account view (limits and counts); a key never orders new objects and never receives a new object's shown-once token.

nip98.description: The signed NIP-98 event (base64 of its JSON) for exactly the request the signature_required answer of the same call named. Sign it with your own Nostr signer (local key, NIP-46 bunker or a signer tool); never send the private key itself, in any form (nsec, hex or seed words).
